item.title: New Challenge: PhD in Computer Science
item.description:
Some dreams take time to come true. But when they do, they have a special flavor.

I am now starting a new academic journey: entering the PhD program in Computer Science at the State University of Maringá (UEM).

It is a phase that deeply excites me and, at the same time, challenges me to keep learning, researching, and contributing to the field I chose to pursue.

Bring on this new phase!
